subject: Woven by Toyota's data curation - why you might care
text:
Hi [NAME],

We've recently onboarded Woven by Toyota as customers, so I thought it'd make sense to reach out to see if we can help you and the team in a similar way.

Like hundreds of CV & ML Ops teams who have come to us with their challenges, Woven's Computer Vision team faced problems with data curation (Voxel51 & internal tools), where they lacked the speed & scalability required to efficiently search through their training datasets.

At Encord, we've built a high-performance architecture to support indexing and searching through billions of video and image data items (using embeddings visualisations, quality metric filters & natural language searches), enabling CV teams to avoid bottlenecks in model development.

Are you open to exploring with me how Encord can help you and the team with your CV data development challenges?

How does a time suit for a call in the coming days? (Or any here: [LINK] suit?)

Very best,
